sources.title: MathsLlama - Llama 3.1-8B Mathematical Reasoning (GRPO)
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enable autonomous mathematical reasoning capabilities. Unlike traditional supervised fine-tuning approaches, this model learned to reason through reinforcement learning without requiring pre-labeled reasoning examples or teacher model distillation.
